div.span: - The producer returns in milliseconds. Competing workers share the orders queue: each message goes to one worker, which acknowledges it only after the work is done. Unacknowledged messages come back if a worker dies.

div.span: - A poison order is retried three times. Then the worker rejects it and the broker routes it through orders.dlx to orders.dlq for a human to inspect.
